summary: Record per-message cleanup and undo progress so recovery preserves manual changes and avoids resending uncertain writes.
reason: Chunk-only state cannot distinguish an untouched message from one manually changed after a crash; the independent cleanup retry loop could also replay a request after an ambiguous response.
validated_outcome: Offline fake-Gmail tests cover crash recovery, partial undo, later cleanups, manual moves after untrash, ledger stamp failures, rejected 429 trash recovery, and post-commit errors that must not resend trash or placement writes. An existing-store migration test covers the untrash label snapshot. No live Gmail API call was made.
